entries.title: Proverbs 17:1
segments: ¶Better a bit of dry bread in peace, than a house full of feasting and violent behaviour.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:2
segments: ¶A servant who does wisely will have rule over a son causing shame, and will have his part in the heritage among brothers.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:3
segments: ¶The heating-pot is for silver and the oven-fire for gold, but the Lord is the tester of hearts.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:4
segments: ¶A wrongdoer gives attention to evil lips, and a man of deceit gives ear to a damaging tongue.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:5
segments: ¶Whoever makes sport of the poor puts shame on his Maker; and he who is glad because of trouble will not go free from punishment.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:6
segments: ¶Children's children are the crown of old men, and the glory of children is their fathers.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:7
segments: ¶Fair words are not to be looked for from a foolish man, much less are false lips in a ruler.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:8
segments: ¶An offering of money is like a stone of great price in the eyes of him who has it: wherever he goes, he does well.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:9
segments: ¶He who keeps a sin covered is looking for love; but he who keeps on talking of a thing makes division between friends.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:10
segments: ¶A word of protest goes deeper into one who has sense than a hundred blows into a foolish man.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:11
segments: ¶An uncontrolled man is only looking for trouble, so a cruel servant will be sent against him.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:12
segments: ¶It is better to come face to face with a bear whose young ones have been taken away than with a foolish man acting foolishly.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:13
segments: ¶If anyone gives back evil for good, evil will never go away from his house.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:14
segments: ¶The start of fighting is like the letting out of water: so give up before it comes to blows.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:15
segments: ¶He who gives a decision for the evil-doer and he who gives a decision against the upright, are equally disgusting to the Lord.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:16
segments: ¶How will money in the hand of the foolish get him wisdom, seeing that he has no sense?

entries.title: Proverbs 17:17
segments: ¶A friend is loving at all times, and becomes a brother in times of trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:18
segments: ¶A man without sense gives his hand in an agreement, and makes himself responsible before his neighbour.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:19
segments: ¶The lover of fighting is a lover of sin: he who makes high his doorway is looking for destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:20
segments: ¶Nothing good comes to him whose heart is fixed on evil purposes: and he who has an evil tongue will come to trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:21
segments: ¶He who has an unwise son gets sorrow for himself, and the father of a foolish son has no joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:22
segments: ¶A glad heart makes a healthy body, but a crushed spirit makes the bones dry.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:23
segments: ¶A sinner takes an offering out of his robe, to get a decision for himself in a cause.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:24
segments: ¶Wisdom is before the face of him who has sense; but the eyes of the foolish are on the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:25
segments: ¶A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitter pain to her who gave him birth.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:26
segments: ¶To give punishment to the upright is not good, or to give blows to the noble for their righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:27
segments: ¶He who has knowledge says little: and he who has a calm spirit is a man of good sense.

entries.title: Proverbs 17:28
segments: Even the foolish man, when he keeps quiet, is taken to be wise: when his lips are shut he is credited with good sense.
